data.long_meaning: A woman who goes on a journey or travel. The name Raidah carries the meaning “Journey, Travel” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Raidah usually hope their child will grow to embody journey, travel and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raidah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_english.name: Raidah
in_english.meaning: meaning: first, pioneering, innovative, responsible, courageous, forward-thinking
in_english.long_meaning: etymology: raa, 'ayn, daal, ya'. Raidah is an Islamic name that symbolizes a woman who is responsible, courageous, and forward-thinking. It is a name that represents the first female in a group or organization. In Islamic tradition, Raidah is also the name of one of the Prophet Muhammad's female servants. The name has gained popularity over the years in different Muslim cultures and is now widely used in many countries. In modern times, Raidah represents a woman who is innovative, responsible, and courageous, with a forward-thinking approach to life.
